_doc: RGB-ANNAbel stage-2 parity fixture, written by manim/tools/make_stage2_fixtures.py from the real fuentes/rgb-annabel/annabel_app/core (Stage2Problem, step_fn, run_stage2, _xcheck, build_net, train_model) with PyTorch 2.15.0 and the Stage2Config defaults. Arrays are base64 little-endian {f32|f64}, row-major in the app's shapes: J (Nt, Nz, Nr, 3) per mm, X2 (Nt*Nz2*Nr, 3), Y2 (Nt, Nz2, Nr, 3), K (3, NT), parameters in state_dict order (p_prev and p_last after steps N-1 and N), T and fs (Nt, Nz, Nr). T_cf and fs_cf use -1 for NaN.
